_: Paths that scripts/guard-protected-paths.mjs refuses to let a tool write.
Git-tracked ON PURPOSE. This is the only exception mechanism the guard
honours, because it is the only one the agent cannot change without leaving
a reviewable diff. The task queue's `paths` field and
.skills-agent/decisions.json are deliberately NOT trusted as authorization:
the same agent writes both, so relying on them would be circular.
`exceptions` is normally empty. Adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewable
act that narrows the protection for one specific path.
